text:
Nia (CS): Ping team - CardiacAI wants to port their in-house finetuned 13B clinical summarizer into Redwood Private. Requirements: strict PHI controls, HSM KMS, VPC-only control plane, and a pre-renewal regression/safety eval. Theyre asking for a perf target of p95 <= 170ms for ~500-token outputs at ~20-40 qps. Can we take this on?

Jorge (AM): Ill confirm the renewal window and budget constraints. They prefer A10G for cost but can accept A100 if needed. Renewal likelihood: "considering" — they want the eval before committing to a yearly contract.

Ivy (ML Eng): 170ms p95 on a 13B for 500 tokens is tight on A10G. Need artifacts: model bundle (HF tar or ONNX), tokenizer file, 50 representative prompts, and a small latency trace. If they can provide a staging endpoint latency trace that helps a lot. Otherwise we'll propose quantization (8-bit) + KV caching or a distilled 7B fallback.

Hassan (Security): HSM + VPC private control plane supported. Security needs: signed DPA, detailed dataflow diagram showing PHI ingress/egress, retention & log policy, and external integrations list (EHR connectors, SFTP). If they want zero retention we need an exception for audits. Also confirm whether they perform any client-side de-identification.

Nia (CS): Action items: 1) Ask CardiacAI for artifact bundle + dataflow diagram + sample prompts (due 3 business days). 2) Ivy to produce perf feasibility + config recs (3bd). 3) Hassan to draft HSM/onboarding checklist (3bd). 4) Request short Dedicated eval pool for profiling (5bd). I'll open the shared intake doc and add owners. Marking renewal-risk: "watch" until eval completes.

Ivy (ML Eng): To speed profiling, please have them run this quick curl against a staging endpoint and paste timings:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.cardiacai.example/eval -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"notes":["<note1>","<note2>","<note3>"],"max_tokens":500}' -w '\nTime_total:%{time_total}\n'
```
That gives us a practical time_total baseline.

Hassan (Security): Also request the list of any third-party services that see PHI and whether encryption-in-transit/end-to-end is enforced. I'll prepare the SOC2/HIPAA checklist questions.

OnboardBot: Intake ticket created: CS-2026-5233. Assigned to Nia (CS), Ivy (ML Eng), Hassan (Security). Provision ETA for eval workspace: 1799998000.

Nia (CS): Thanks OnboardBot. I'll message CardiacAI now and post the intake doc link here when received. If artifacts arrive early we can try to provision within 48-72 hours.

Jorge (AM): I'll prep a short cost delta note (A10G vs A100 vs quantized) once Ivy posts the perf matrix.

Ivy (ML Eng): ack. If we see early perf shortfalls, plan is to offer a quantized 13B or a distilled 7B with identical safety evals.

Hassan (Security): ack, will post checklist and call out any red flags for PHI processing.

Nia (CS): Closing loop for now. Will update thread after kickoff meeting is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
